run_events_gate_idx.query: SELECT seq,payload FROM run_events INDEXED BY run_events_gate_idx WHERE run_id=? AND "run_events"."type"='decision.made' AND CASE WHEN json_valid("run_events"."payload") THEN json_type("run_events"."payload",'$.gate') IS NOT NULL ELSE 1 END ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT 1

run_events_fresh_session_idx.query: SELECT seq,payload FROM run_events INDEXED BY run_events_fresh_session_idx WHERE run_id=? AND "run_events"."type"='run.resumed' AND CASE WHEN json_valid("run_events"."payload") THEN json_type("run_events"."payload",'$.freshSession') IS NOT NULL ELSE 1 END ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT 20
